::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feb 18 1868  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55388 (1): P.27
:::

Dear Miss Yonge,
How do you like the enclosed pages & title page? Will you kindly consult [Miss Sewell](people/person_1301.qmd), the first title was her suggestion.[^1] [I](people/person_939.qmd) am [*illegible*]
home at the [*illegible*]

Yours very truly
A. Macmillan

---

[^1]: This relates to the choice of title for the anthology of historical writing edited by CMY and Elizabeth Sewell, eventually published as *Historical Selections: A Series of Readings from the Best Authorities in English and European History*.
